functions.name: check_supply
functions.doc:
Sanity check used by tests and the verification script. Anyone can call
 the view; it is intentionally cheap and does not iterate accounts.

functions.name: claim_faucet
functions.doc: Demo-only starter tokens. Disabled outside `demo_mode` deployments.

functions.name: claim_reward
functions.doc:
Claim a winner's share of the day's fixed mint pool. Shares are
 proportional to base power, so the underdog bonus never changes the split.

functions.name: claim_season
functions.doc: Claim a winning faction member's share of the season bonus.

functions.name: claim_stake
functions.doc:
Return a stake. Winners and cold/tie days pay 100%; the losing faction
 receives `100% - loss_burn_bp`. The burn already happened at settlement,
 so this only moves the survivor from `locked_total` back to balance.

functions.name: close_claims
functions.doc:
After `claim_window_days`, anyone can burn the unclaimed part of a day's
 reward pool. Stakes themselves never expire, so users can always reclaim
 their locked tokens (including on a cold/tie day).

functions.name: enlist
functions.doc:
Stake once per day. Automatically settles up to `MAX_SETTLE_DAYS`
 overdue days, so the game heals itself without a cron job.

functions.name: get_locked_total
functions.doc:
Guard used by tests: a positive stake on a settled day must never make
 `locked_total` negative. Returns the locked bucket for inspection.

functions.name: get_log
functions.doc:
`from` is a global log id, not a ring index. Newest entries have the
 highest ids. `limit` is clamped to 100.

functions.name: get_log_tail
functions.doc: Most recent `limit` events, oldest-first. For the live event feed.

functions.name: join_faction
functions.doc:
Join DOGS (0) or CATS (1). Exactly once per account; there is no faction
 switching, so season power can be keyed by `(season, account)`.

functions.name: new
functions.doc:
The only initialization entry point. There is no second call and no
 way to change any field afterwards.

functions.name: settle_day
functions.doc:
Settle one finished day. Permissionless and idempotent: repeating a
 settled day panics without changing state, and days must be settled in
 order so the underdog/streak/season bookkeeping stays deterministic.

functions.name: storage_unregister
functions.doc:
This token does not support force deregistration: a positive balance is
 never silently burned. Keep `force` in the signature for NEP-145.

reward_payout.description: What `claim_reward` would pay right now (0 if none/already claimed/closed).

stake_payout.description: What `claim_stake` would pay right now (0 if already claimed or unsettled).

Config.description:
All game parameters. Written once in `new()` and never mutable.

Amounts are in the token's smallest unit. Ratios are basis points (10_000 = 100%). There is deliberately no `set_config`, `pause`, `upgrade` or treasury-withdraw method anywhere in the contract.

base_power_winner.description: Base power of the winning faction, used as the reward-share denominator.

effective_power.description: Power after the underdog bonus; this is what decides the winner.

rewards_closed.description: Set once the reward claim window closes; unclaimed rewards are burned.

total_power.description: Sum of individual base power (stake * streak multiplier).

season_tiles.description: Tiles captured in the active season; reset when the season settles.

data.description: Extra event fields as a JSON object string. The frontend parses this.

locked_stake.description: Nominal stake still locked on this account's unclaimed enlistments. Losers receive 80% of a stake, but the full stake is removed here on claim.

rewards_closed.description: Set when the next season's settlement burns any unclaimed bonus.
